items.t: Buy, Sell, or Hold? Tuesday’s Top Upgrades and Downgrades: Cloudflare, Deckers Outdoors, DraftKings, MongoDB, Nike, Oneok, Philip Morris International, Riot Platforms, Wix.com, and More
items.sum: A two-day rally built partly on short covering faces its first real test when October inflation data lands at 8:30 ET. Meanwhile, analysts flipped hard on Wix and DraftKings, while a surprise double upgrade lifted a bitcoin miner's target.
